description: NaSiCSbO₇ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁ space group. Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.18-2.95 Å. Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent SbO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 38-44°. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.63-1.66 Å. C is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There are a spread of C-O bond distances ranging from 1.22-1.36 Å. Sb is bonded to six O atoms to form SbO₆ octahedra that share corners with four equivalent SiO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Sb-O bond distances ranging from 1.95-2.07 Å. There are seven inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to one Na and one C atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted T-shaped geometry to one Na, one C, and one Sb atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to one Na, one C, and one Sb atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Si and one Sb atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Si, and one Sb atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Si, and one Sb atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Si, and one Sb atom.
